description: This file contains utility functions for plotting training logs and evaluation metrics in an object detection project, including functions for visualizing logs and precision-recall curves.

methods.name: plot_logs
methods.description: Plots specified fields from training logs, including training and test results, with optional exponential weighted smoothing.

methods.name: plot_precision_recall
methods.description: Plots precision-recall and score-recall curves from saved evaluation data files, with options for naming schemes.
